translations.web: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.
translations.bsb: There you are to sacrifice your peace offerings, eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt offer peace offerings, and shalt eat there, and rejoice before the LORD thy God.
translations.asv: and thou shalt sacrifice peace-offerings, and shalt eat there; and thou shalt rejoice before Jehovah thy God.
